subject: Azure co-sell: evidence triage and application next steps
messages:
From: Amit Patel <amit@cloudpartners.io>
To: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Azure Marketplace Team <azure-marketplace@microsoft.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Azure co-sell: initial evidence and application draft

Hi Logan / Marissa,

Thanks again for taking the call yesterday. Per our conversation, attaching a draft of the Azure co-sell application and a short note on the evidence we typically need to get through the Marketplace validation. If we can get the items below by EOD Friday we should be able to submit next week and get faster intake with the Azure GTM team.

Key items requested:
- Completed application PDF (attached: azure-co-sell-application-draft.pdf)
- Customer references (names + short use case blurbs)
- Security/compliance evidence (SOC2 report, data residency statement)
- Technical evidence: performance snapshot, benchmark summary, RAM/GPU usage patterns
- Pricing & SKU mapping to Azure SKUs and marketplace entitlements

Attachment: azure-co-sell-application-draft.pdf (pdf, 210 KB)

Would you prefer us to run the initial intake through the Azure portal or submit on your behalf? I can cc the marketplace contact to speed review once the PDF is finalized.

Thanks,
Amit Patel
Partner Lead, CloudPartners Inc.
--
Amit Patel
CloudPartners Inc.
Phone: +1 415 555 0142

From: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.ai>
To: Amit Patel <amit@cloudpartners.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Jun 2028 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Azure co-sell: initial evidence and application draft

Thanks Amit — got it. I'll triage and assign owners internally. Quick plan:

- Ben: own the technical evidence packet (perf snapshot, VM/GPU sizing, KV cache notes).
- Marissa: lead pricing & SKU mapping and customer references.
- Vanessa: own GTM readiness / co-sell entitlements and partner onboarding checklist.

I attached a short audit checklist (audit-evidence-list.xlsx) that maps the Azure ask to Redwood artifacts — please review and flag any missing items. Can everyone confirm ownership and an ETA? Ideally, we bundle a PDF and submit to Azure Marketplace contact Amit cc'd.

Logan
Head of Partnerships (acting)
Redwood Inference

Attachment: audit-evidence-list.xlsx (xlsx, 42 KB)

Date: Tue, 20 Jun 2028 11:25:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Azure co-sell: initial evidence and application draft

Thanks Logan / Amit — assigning notes from my side:

1) Pricing & SKU mapping — I need the proposed SKU matrix for the marketplace (how we want to represent Dedicated vs Hosted units). Ben, can you confirm any technical constraints that would affect SKU granularity (e.g., we shouldn't expose fractional GPU units)?

2) Customer references — I can draft two short blurbs. Logan, can you provide the contact names & one-line outcomes? Preferably customers comfortable with being referenced in partner collateral.

3) Compliance evidence — Security will need SOC2 + a short data residency bullet for Azure regions. I will pull the standard compliance pack but need confirmation on retention policy for marketplace copies.

Action items:
- Marissa: draft pricing mapping + two reference blurbs (ETA: Thu 6/22 EOD)
- Ben: technical evidence (see Logan notes)
- Vanessa: confirm co-sell readiness checklist (partner entitlement, co-selling playbook)

Also Amit — if Azure requires a signed application we can push via DocuSign. Add the Azure GTM alias as a cc and we'll coordinate.

Marissa Cole
Director, GTM Partnerships
Redwood Inference

I'll take technical evidence. Notes / plan: 

- I'll produce a performance snapshot for our 8k and 16k context models (latency p95, token cost), and a short VM sizing recommendation for Azure SKUs.
- I'll include a KV cache summary and explain how prefix caching reduces per-token bill.
- ETA: initial packet by Thu 6/22 EOD; final by Mon 6/26 after internal review.

Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Perfect — appreciate the quick ownership. I'll go ahead and cc the Azure Marketplace inbox so they have sight of timelines. Two small asks from Azure side:

1) Signed application PDF (they prefer a PDF with a signatory name and email). DocuSign link is OK.
2) A short one-page tech summary that can be attached to the listing (this is customer-facing).

Once you have Ben's perf packet and Marissa's SKU mapping, send the combined PDF to azure-marketplace@microsoft.com and I'll follow up internally to push through the intake queue.

Attachment: azure-co-sell-application-draft.pdf (pdf, 210 KB)

Thanks,
Amit
